Four numbers, struck by hand

The stamp inside every piece says how many parts in a thousand are pure gold.

  1. 58514 karat

    Hard-wearing gold for hoops and rings you never take off.

  2. 75018 karat

    Our house standard for signets and pendants. Warm, weighty, made to be engraved.

  3. 91622 karat

    Soft and deeply yellow, the bangle gold Istanbul has worn for generations.

  4. 999.9fine gold

    Pure enough only for bars and coins, never for jewelry.

Looked after for life

What comes with every piece, at no charge.

  • Ring sizing

    We post a sizer before you order, and resize once within 60 days.

  • Engraving

    Initials or a date inside any band, cut by hand.

  • Care

    Cleaning and a fresh polish whenever you send it back.

  • Delivery

    Insured and signed for, in a wooden box. Unengraved pieces return within 30 days.
